motions.title: Tadgedale Quarry Variation Application
motions.full_text: Permit the application for variation of condition 2 to allow changes to the approved site layout and house type plans for 128 dwellings at Tadgedale Quarry, subject to conditions relating to the revised plans and any other conditions still relevant to the original decision.
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition will argue loss of green space, over‑development, impact on the Grade II listed milestone and will seek to reduce the number of dwellings and increase open‑space provision.
motions.ruling_group_response: Emphasise that the variation reduces dwellings to 106, that the development complies with NPPF paragraph 131 and PSD7, that the listed milestone's setting is unaffected, and that affordable housing mix meets local policy.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Reduce dwellings to 100 and add a requirement for a community green space of 0.5 hectares.
amendment_predictions.counter: Accept the reduction to 100 as a friendly amendment and highlight that the original reduction to 106 already addresses green‑space concerns.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Insert a clause requiring a detailed ecological impact assessment for the listed milestone.
amendment_predictions.counter: Offer to commission an independent survey and attach the report as a condition, satisfying the amendment.

key_data_points: Grade II listed milestone on site
Open countryside location on Local Plan map

motions.title: Land off Bar Hill Road Development Application
motions.full_text: Permit the development of 155 dwellings at Land off Bar Hill Road, Madeley, subject to conditions linking to the outline planning permission, approved plans, facing materials, boundary treatments, provision of cycle and bin storage, drainage details, arboricultural details, parking and turning areas, and a prohibition on converting garages to living purposes.
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition will raise concerns about visual amenity, highway safety, and the impact on existing infrastructure, and may seek to limit the number of dwellings or impose stricter design conditions.
motions.ruling_group_response: Point out compliance with Local Plan policy MD29, that the design meets NPPF criteria, and that the proposed infrastructure provisions (cycle storage, drainage) mitigate impact.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Add a condition for a traffic impact assessment and a mitigation plan.
amendment_predictions.counter: Agree to attach the assessment as a condition, turning the amendment into a supportive addition.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Reduce dwellings to 130 and require a 10% affordable housing contribution.
amendment_predictions.counter: Accept the reduction as a compromise and note that affordable housing provision is already in line with policy.

motions.title: Well Street and Garden Street Change of Use Application
motions.full_text: Permit the change of use of an existing office (Use Class E) to provide two houses in multiple occupancy (Use Class C4) at 25‑27 Well Street and 82 Garden Street, subject to conditions on time limit, approved plans, glazing, construction hours, environmental management plan, bin storage, and cycle storage.
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition will focus on the increase in HMO proportion from 16% to 22%, potential anti‑social behaviour, impact on the conservation area, and will demand detailed HMO data and frontage definition.
motions.ruling_group_response: Present the latest council licensing data confirming the HMO proportion remains within policy limits, argue that the development adds needed housing and meets HOU7 criteria, and offer to provide a detailed frontage plan as a condition.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Insert a clause limiting the total HMO units on the site to 2 and requiring a management plan.
amendment_predictions.counter: Agree to the limitation as it aligns with the proposal of two houses, and attach a management plan condition.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Add a condition for a community liaison officer to monitor anti‑social behaviour.
amendment_predictions.counter: Accept the condition as a supportive measure that enhances community confidence.

key_data_points: Site within Newcastle town centre conservation area

motions.title: Five‑Year Housing Land Supply Update Report
motions.full_text: That members note the content of the five‑year housing land supply position statement and agree that it represents the current housing land supply position and can be used as a material consideration for development management decision making.
motions.opposition_strategy: Opposition may question the adequacy of the supply figure and request clarification on the 20% buffer applied.
motions.ruling_group_response: Explain the methodology, reference the NPPF paragraph 78 and the 20% buffer justified by recent policy updates, and note that the council has exceeded delivery targets.

amendment_predictions.amendment_angle: Amend to request a separate statement on affordable housing provision.
amendment_predictions.counter: Agree to attach an affordable housing annex, turning the amendment into a constructive addition.

key_data_points: Council exceeded delivery test over three years

questions.question_text: Will the variation reduce the amount of open countryside and affect the listed milestone?
questions.trap_explanation: Resident may demand a full environmental impact study, which could delay the decision.

questions.topic: Traffic impact of Bar Hill Road development
questions.question_text: Has a traffic impact assessment been carried out and what mitigation is proposed?
recommended_answer_points: Assessment will be attached as a condition
Proposed cycle storage and drainage reduce traffic pressure
questions.trap_explanation: If the assessment is not ready, the question could force a postponement.

questions.question_text: How does the Well Street application affect the overall HMO proportion in the neighbourhood?
recommended_answer_points: Current proportion 16% rising to 22% remains within HOU7 limits
Two units only, with management plan
Data from council licensing records will be provided
questions.trap_explanation: May be used to trigger a demand for a full neighbourhood audit.

tactical_scenarios.scenario: Opposition tables an amendment to cut dwellings at Tadgedale Quarry to 90 units.
tactical_scenarios.counter: Accept a compromise to 100 units and highlight that the original reduction to 106 already addresses concerns.
tactical_scenarios.standing_order: SO 12 - Amendments must be seconded and debated before vote.

tactical_scenarios.scenario: Member requests a postponement to gather further evidence on HMO impacts.
tactical_scenarios.counter: Refuse postponement citing that all required data is already on record and that the meeting schedule must be maintained.
tactical_scenarios.standing_order: SO 8 - Motion to adjourn must be seconded and voted.

tactical_scenarios.scenario: A recorded vote is challenged on procedural grounds.
tactical_scenarios.counter: Ensure that the motion was properly seconded, that the correct number of members were present, and that the vote was recorded accurately.
tactical_scenarios.standing_order: SO 15 - Recorded votes must be entered in the minutes.

time_management.recommended_time_saving: Use friendly amendments on motions 4 and 6 to limit debate and allocate 5 minutes for each amendment discussion.
